title: Open problem: Subdiffusive and KPZ passage-time fluctuation exponents
body:
OPEN PROBLEM from the Codex campaign ledger (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). Under suitable nondegenerate iid passage-time assumptions, prove a fluctuation exponent strictly below1/2, identify the planar exponent as1/3, and establish a positive exponent in a suitable dimension. Source: Auffinger, Damron and Hanson: 50 years of first-passage percolation, Questions13 and15, PDF pp.34 and40; Section3.
